scripts.cms:snapshot: docker compose exec directus npx directus schema snapshot --yes /directus/snapshots/schema.yaml
scripts.cms:apply: docker compose exec directus npx directus schema apply --yes /directus/snapshots/schema.yaml
scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dump -U directus -Fc directus > backups/directus-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).dump
